rationale: Repository preflight and PR #299 falsification proved that reviewed generic concept education has no existing publication/admission authority. Reusing RuleCertificationResult would misclassify education as an operative insurance rule, and weakening ordinary USER_ANSWER evidence admission would violate the existing product-evidence trust boundary.
authority_impact: Introduces a bounded education-only publication and admission authority. It authorizes reviewed generic concept education for CUSTOMER_EDUCATION use only and explicitly cannot authorize operative product facts, entitlement, claim payment, recommendations, customer-specific inference, or ordinary authoritative product evidence.
